controlTest.positiveScenario: Ingest synthetic events into `index=nac` sourcetype='cisco:ise:syslog' that satisfy the UC-17.1.37 SPL filters for 'ISE-Cisco ACI / Cisco Secure Workload SGT Binding Synchronisation'. Run the saved search and confirm at least one alertable row with expected fields populated.
controlTest.negativeScenario: Ingest benign `nac` / `cisco:ise:syslog` events outside the detection threshold, or exclude the test entity via `network_exception_register.csv` with a valid window. Confirm zero alert rows for UC-17.1.37.

dataSources: ISE syslog `index=nac sourcetype=cisco:ise:syslog` *TrustSec* and *pxGrid* categories — codes `83020` (SGT-EPG mapping created), `83021` (SGT-EPG mapping deleted), `83022` (SGT-EPG mapping update failed). The Cisco ACI APIC controller syslog `index=network sourcetype=cisco:apic` reports `epg_static_path_change` and `EPG-binding-failure` events. Cisco Secure Workload (formerly Tetration) reports its scope-binding via the OpenAPI `/openapi/v1/inventory_filters` polled by a custom modular input.
app: `Splunk Add-on for Cisco Identity Services` ([Splunkbase 1915](https://splunkbase.splunk.com/app/1915)) + `Cisco ACI Connector` ([Splunkbase 4309](https://splunkbase.splunk.com/app/4309)) + custom Secure Workload poller.
spl:
(index=nac sourcetype="cisco:ise:syslog" MessageCode IN (83020, 83021, 83022))
  OR (index=network sourcetype="cisco:apic" event_type IN ("epg_static_path_change", "EPG-binding-failure"))
| stats count latest(_time) as last_event, count(eval(MessageCode=="83022" OR event_type=="EPG-binding-failure")) as failures by sgt_name, epg_name
| where failures > 0
| sort - failures
description: Detects SGT-to-EPG (Cisco ACI Endpoint Group) binding synchronisation failures and SGT-to-Secure-Workload-scope binding update failures — symptoms of integration drift between ISE TrustSec policy and Cisco ACI / Secure Workload enforcement.
value: When ISE's TrustSec policy and ACI/Secure Workload enforcement diverge, traffic that ISE classified as 'production' may be enforced by ACI as 'staging' (or vice versa). Catching binding-update failures in real time prevents silent classification drift.
implementation: Onboard ACI APIC syslog into `index=network`. Onboard Secure Workload binding events via the OpenAPI poller. Schedule the search every 30 min, search window `-1h@h to @h`, trigger on count > 0.
visualization: (1) Single value: count of failed bindings last 24h. (2) Sankey: sgt_name → epg_name → status (success/failure). (3) Top-N table: SGTs with most failed bindings.

references.title: Cisco ISE 3.4 Admin Guide — TrustSec / ACI Integration

knownFalsePositives:
1. **Certificate or EAP profile rollout** — Clients fail EAP-TLS during staged cert deployment for 'ISE-Cisco ACI / Cisco Secure Workload SGT Binding Synchronisation'. Cross-check `FailureReason` and CMDB cert expiry.

2. **RADIUS/PSN maintenance restart** — Short auth failure burst while ISE node restarts. Match change window on `index=changes`.

3. **Guest or IoT onboarding surge** — Legitimate MAC registration spike skews `index=nac` `cisco:ise:syslog` baselines.

4. **Approved pen-test or scanner traffic** — Red-team exercises from netblock in `approved_scanners.csv` mimic auth failures.

**Suppression mechanism:** `network_exception_register.csv` keyed on `CallingStationID`, `NAS-IP-Address`, `valid_until`.
detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• ISE-ACI integration configured (Administration > pxGrid Services > ACI Settings).
• ACI APIC syslog forwarded to Splunk.
• Splunk credentials for the Secure Workload OpenAPI; modular input or cron poller.
• `sgt_epg_mapping.csv` lookup (SGT → expected EPG).

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Enable ISE *TrustSec* category at INFO. Verify ACI APIC syslog is arriving at `index=network sourcetype=cisco:apic`.

Step 2 — Create the search
Search in `spl` field. Schedule every 30 min.

Step 3 — Validate
Provoke a binding failure as in controlTest. Confirm fire.

Step 4 — Operationalize
Dashboard panels listed above. Slack notification to `#network-segmentation-platform`.

Step 5 — Troubleshooting
• **No ACI syslog events** — APIC syslog target not configured. Configure under APIC: Admin > External Data Collectors > Syslog.
• **Binding-failure events from ISE without ACI events** — APIC may be reachable but Secure Workload integration broken. Validate Secure Workload OpenAPI auth.
• **Persistent failures for one SGT** — That SGT has no matching EPG defined in ACI. Coordinate with the ACI admin to create or rename the EPG.

Step 1 — Configure data collection

Install and configure the add-on referenced in the app field (`Splunk Add-on for Cisco Identity Services` ([Splunkbase 1915](https://splunkbase.splunk.com/app/1915)) + `Cisco ACI Connector` ([Splunkbase 4309](https://splunkbase.splunk.com/app/4309)) + custom Secure Workload poller.). Enable the modular input or HEC token that writes sourcetype=cisco:ise:syslog, cisco:apic into nac, network. Default poll interval 300–900 seconds unless the vendor API rate-limits lower. Grant the ingestion role `list_inputs` and `search` on the target index.

Step 2 — Create the search and alert

Schedule the SPL with earliest=-24h@h and throttle per entity to avoid duplicate pages. Document tunable macros in the comment header. Understanding this SPL: filters in the first pipeline reduce license cost; stats/timechart aggregates define the alert grain; joins/lookups enrich owner or asset metadata for routing.

Step 3 — Validate

Compare `| tstats count where index=... sourcetype=...` against the vendor admin UI inventory count (+/-5%). Spot-check two known entities for field presence (`epg_name, failures, sgt_name`). Run `timechart count span=1h` over 7 days to find ingestion gaps longer than two poll intervals.

Step 4 — Operationalize

Add a dashboard row with single-value KPI tiles, a 24-hour timechart, and a drilldown table mirroring the SPL output columns. Route critical severity to the platform on-call channel; route warning to the service owner from the lookup.

Step 5 — Troubleshooting

No events: verify forwarder connectivity, HEC token ACLs, and that the modular input appears in `index=_internal source=*splunkd*`. NULL fields: check props/transforms order and TA version. Fewer results than expected: confirm index allow-lists on the search head role and that `_time` uses the correct timezone. API errors: inspect splunkd.log for HTTP 401/429 from the vendor endpoint configured in inputs.conf.
grandmaExplanation: ISE labels users by group, but the data-centre fabric and the workload-protection tool need to know about the same groups. We make sure those tools agree with ISE — and ring the bell when one of them refuses a label, so security rules stay consistent.
